description: Native gate unavailable (blocked) predicts native gates still not all pass on later re-execution
failure: The environment cause persists: no native host intake bound (CORE_SYMBOL_GAME_HOST or an explicit native binding), or a sandbox runtime artifact access denied. Rerunning gates without changing that environment leaves native_all_pass false.

lesson.applicability: Runs where host_native_gates reports blocked with failure_code NATIVE_GATE_UNAVAILABLE, such as NATIVE_HOST_INTAKE_UNAVAILABLE or RUNTIME_ARTIFACT_UNAVAILABLE.
lesson.cause: The environment cause persists: no native host intake bound (CORE_SYMBOL_GAME_HOST or an explicit native binding), or a sandbox runtime artifact access denied. Rerunning gates without changing that environment leaves native_all_pass false.
lesson.correction: Fix the native binding or artifact access before the gates are rerun. If it cannot be fixed, record native coverage as incomplete and do not assert that gates pass.
lesson.exceptions: Does not apply if the native host binding or artifact permission is changed between the blocked observation and the next gate execution.
lesson.failed_claim: Native gate unavailability was transient or incidental, and re-executing the gates later in the run would produce a full pass.
lesson.verification: Host replay of recorded host facts over 48 runs: the detector fired in 3 and the outcome followed every time. Proposed by claude-sonnet-5-5. This does not rerun the old checks or show that the guidance helps later runs.

repair: Fix the native binding or artifact access before the gates are rerun. If it cannot be fixed, record native coverage as incomplete and do not assert that gates pass.
